{{Infobox artifact|name=The Chronicle of Victory|type=The authorized history|keeper=[[House Blackcrest]], at [[Crown-watch]]|sources=Itself — which is the problem}}
The '''Chronicle of Victory''' is the authorized history of [[the Banner-lands]], kept and guarded by [[House Blackcrest]]. It is read aloud each year in every hall from [[the Sleep Coast]] to [[the Edgelands]], and in four centuries no one has improved a word of it — which the house that keeps it counts as proof.

It tells of eleven noble leaders, an outside enemy, and concord. It never mentions how eleven became ten — the text simply ''skips''. Beautiful, coherent, and — say its quieter critics — almost certainly false in the most important respect.

Its defenders answer with four hundred years of peace: the Chronicle is the realm's second peace — the first was won with swords and would not have held a decade; what held it was a story everyone could live inside. Whoever calls that a lie must answer what four centuries without civil war is called.
